output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Amazon.com, Inc.'s latest filed list of significant subsidiaries names: Amazon.com Services LLC; Amazon.com Sales, Inc.; Amazon Data Services, Inc.; Amazon Web Services, Inc.; Amazon Technologies, Inc.; Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLC; Amazon US Services LLC; A100 ROW, Inc.; and Day One Insurance, Inc. The list is not a complete register of every Amazon subsidiary: Amazon's latest quarterly filing says its consolidated entities include wholly owned subsidiaries and variable-interest entities, including entities supporting healthcare services and video production and distribution.
caveats: Amazon's filings publish a list of significant subsidiaries, not a comprehensive list of every legal entity it owns or controls; subsidiaries may change before the next annual Exhibit 21 filing.

The answer uses the latest named subsidiary list available in the filed 2025 Form 10-K, while the more recent September 30, 2026 Form 10-Q confirms the broader consolidated-entity structure but does not provide a replacement named-subsidiary schedule.

The consolidated financial statements include the accounts of Amazon.com, Inc. and its consolidated entities (collectively, the “Company”), consisting of its wholly-owned subsidiaries and those entities in which we have a variable interest (“VIEs”) and of which we are the primary beneficiary, including certain entities in India and certain entities that support our healthcare services and production and distribution of video content.

output.question: What are Amazon's subsidiaries?

key_facts.fact: Amazon's 2025 Form 10-K Exhibit 21.1 lists nine significant subsidiaries: Amazon.com Services LLC, Amazon.com Sales, Inc., Amazon Data Services, Inc., Amazon Web Services, Inc., Amazon Technologies, Inc., Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLC, Amazon US Services LLC, A100 ROW, Inc., and Day One Insurance, Inc.; each is shown as 100% owned.

Amazon's latest quarterly filing, for the period ended September 30, 2026, describes the consolidated company as including wholly owned subsidiaries and variable-interest entities, including certain entities in India and entities supporting healthcare services and video-content production and distribution.
